newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed unit to hire 3,000 people.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed unit to hire 3,000 people.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp's Lockheed Martin Missiles & Space unit said it has accelerated its recruitment efforts due to an increased need for people with expertise in software, electrical, and systems engineering and expects to hire approximately 3,000 people in Sunnyvale over the next three years.

"We've had a phenomenally successful year highlighted by two major, long-term contract wins," said Mike Henshaw, president of Missiles & Space. "In addition, the commercial and government satellite business moving to Sunnyvale from our East Coast operations has created many challenging job opportunities."

Missiles & Space said it recently received a contract worth about $2 billion to build the Space-Based Infrared Sensor System for the U.S. Air Force and is part of an aerospace industry team that won a $1.1 billion contract for an Air Force Airborne Laser system.
